summary: Inotiv, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant under the company's Credit Agreement for the April 17, 2026 and April 24, 2026 liquidity test dates. The waiver is limited to those specific test dates and does not amend any other Credit Agreement provisions. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisors are stated. This is a routine liquidity covenant waiver, not an M&A, capital return, or restructuring event. It signals near-term liquidity monitoring but lacks structural details of a special situation.
